t: A thumb-sized AI vision board that spots people and objects for your main board.
steps: Buy the Grove Vision AI V2 Kit from Seeed Studio for about 29 US dollars to get a camera too.
Connect the OV5647 camera to the board with the ribbon cable.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open SenseCraft AI in Chrome or Edge and pick the Grove Vision AI V2.
Flash the person detection model and watch the live preview draw boxes.
Install the Arduino IDE and the Seeed Arduino SSCMA library.
Attach a XIAO board and run the library example to print detections in the serial monitor.
meta: Open Board. From $15.99. A few stores.
